answer: Attention Tenure Ledger. Each agent identity must post a velvet escrow that decays with idle time and is only released after continuous verified task activity, so registering many identities costs real withheld capital. A marble audit trail logs every response's uniqueness; clusters of low-diversity, high-volume accounts get flagged and their escrow forfeited rather than refunded. An attacker reaching a summit of N credible identities must therefore sustain N parallel attention budgets for weeks, paying the full opportunity cost of foregone work on each.
